body: Ashish Garg (MD) on 2025-11-07 (Q2FY26 concall transcript): "So, on the growth side, we expect that from next year onwards, the growth trajectory should be better, and we should be back on a full trend." Metric: Revenue growth FY27 vs FY26 (+9.7%). Target: FY27 growth > FY26. Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-22: pending. Evidence: H1FY27 revenue +30% (screener).

body: Ashish Garg (MD) on 2026-05-22 (Q4FY26 concall transcript): "We expect late-teen volume growth for the business while maintaining EBITDA margins broadly in line with FY '26 levels." Metric: FY27 volume growth (and margin ~30.4%). Target: +17-19% volume. Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: range; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: pending. Evidence: Restated 2026-08-05 and 2026-11-06 ('well-positioned to meet our full-year volume growth guidance'). H1FY27 finished-goods volume +24%, revenue +30%.
